mods.name: Enigmatic Legacy
mods.used: The Acknowledgment: its book text, categories, entries, page templates, recipes, GUI and item textures, and item models (rendered into icons).
mods.changes: Modified: the book was converted from the mod's Patchouli JSON into this viewer's format and its text resolved from the en_us language file; item icons were rendered from the mod's models; brewing and hidden recipes were transcribed from the mod's Java source; the book's edition line shows the mod's name instead. The book's wording is unchanged. The converter is tools/build_enigmatic.py.
